summary: The 'CourseAssessment' documents contain several procedures for managing course assessments, including adding, updating, deleting, searching by ID, and validating course assessments. It also involves reading and writing details of assessments through various parameters and database operations.
purpose: The purpose of the 'CourseAssessment' functionality is to manage the lifecycle of course assessments within the system, ensuring proper setup, execution, and validation according to specific business rules and configurations.

workflows.name: Course Assessment Management
steps: Set procedure name for the action (Add, Update, Delete, SearchID, Validation)
Add parameters relevant to the action
Execute query or retrieve data using SqlDataReader
Process and populate the CourseAssessment object based on retrieved data
Format descriptions and open/close days based on conditions

validations: CourseAssessmentValidation checks conditions like InterimWithoutFinal, InstructorsAndSupervisors, and AssessmentMaximumExceeded.
